run_experiment: run an annealed flow transport training experiment using a config file via the main entry point
run_with_custom_config: run the training experiment with a custom config file by passing the --config flag to main
define_config_flag: define a config file flag using config_flags.DEFINE_config_file to accept a training configuration path
review_main_entry: review the main entry point function that validates arguments and delegates to train.run_experiment
summarize_train_pipeline: summarize the training pipeline initiated by main which loads config and calls train.run_experiment
